title: Item Age Allowance in Northgate Protect Repair Values
content:
An age allowance is added to the authorized repair value on a Northgate Protect single-item plan by the days from the coverage start date to the settled claim's incident date: the old-item allowance of $60.00 at 730 days or more, the middle-age allowance of $30.00 at 270 days or more but fewer than 730 days, and nothing for fewer than 270 days.

## Ladder

| Days from coverage start date to the incident date | Age allowance |
|---|---|
| 730 or more | $60.00 |
| 270 to 729 | $30.00 |
| 0 to 269 | Nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold

| Hypothetical days | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 730 | $60.00 |
| 729 | $30.00 |
| 270 | $30.00 |
| 269 | Nothing |

The incident date is the one recorded on the claim being settled; the coverage start date is the one shown on the plan.
